review_candidates.title: Network Operations Center Technician
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Network Operations Center (NOC) Technician is a full-time, remote role responsible for monitoring and supporting TengoInternet’s wireless networks. The technician will troubleshoot and resolve network incidents, provide technical support to clients and internal teams, and escalate complex problems when needed. The NOC Technician collaborates with other network and support professionals to maintain uptime, improve network reliability, and enhance the overall user experience.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) environment, including monitoring network health and responding to alerts.
